# Harbour archive handover receipt

The harbour archive exhibition opened, and the recordings, permissions and withdrawal contacts are now with the museum registrar. This project is complete. Keep the source notes because speakers may change their permissions, but stop creating a new task every time I notice a nicer display idea. [[Exhibition plan]] becomes a record rather than a live checklist. The finished project is allowed to remain valuable without remaining active.
